notes: Implements the debug variant only: 8 real WMT14 en-de source sentences translated with the local read-only Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct container on CUDA (bfloat16, chat template, greedy, max_new_tokens=128). `run` rejects absent inputs before loading the model (exit 78) and fails without CUDA (exit 3); it writes translations.jsonl (id/translation/raw_text/token_ids), run.json with real wall-clock and CUDA-event timings plus per-file model digests, a separate metrics.json for BLEU/chrF, and translation_service_config.json. `translate` is the genuine continuation entry point for new sentences on the same GPU. `doctor --input input` inspects files, model container, tokenizer, torch/transformers and CUDA without running inference and returns 78 if anything is missing. `--help` never imports torch/transformers. BLEU/chrF are honestly reported as null because no references are provided and pre-stored targets are forbidden; the malformed 62-hex manifest digest is recorded, not force-matched. No references, no CPU fallback, no mock weights, no ensembles.
